english translation text: HAZRAT ALI ASGHAR (A.S) HAS BEEN MARTYRED

arabic text: SHAHEED HOGAYE ASGHAR UJER GAYA JULA\nAJAL NE KAR DIYA KHAALI BHARA HUWA JULA
english translation text: HAZRAT ALI ASGHAR (A.S.) HAS BEEN MARTYRED, HIS CRADLE IS NOW EMPTY,\nDESTINY HAS EMPTIED THE CRADLE THAT WAS ONCE OCCUPIED

arabic text: KOI TO KAASH YE KEHTA NA ZAALIMO LUTO,\nKE EK DUKHE HUWE DILKA HAY AASRA JULA
english translation text: IF ONLY SOMEONE WOULD HAVE TOLD THE OPPRESSORS NOT TO LOOT,\nTHIS CRADLE GIVES SOLACE TO A BROKEN HEART

arabic text: THAY MAAKE HAATH RASANME BANDHAY PALAY ASGHAR\nJHULA RAHI THI MAGAR MAAKI MAAMTA JHOOLA
english translation text: THE HANDS THAT HAD LOOKED AFTER ASGHAR (A.S) ARE NOW TIED IN ROPES,\nIT IS A MOTHER’S LOVE THAT NOW SWINGS THE CRADLE

arabic text: KAHANI REH GAI ASGHAR KI KHOON RULANEKO\nNA REH GAYE ALI ASGHAR NA REH GAYA JULA
english translation text: NOW ONLY THE STORY OF ASGHAR (A.S.) REMAINS FOR TEARS OF BLOOD TO BE SHED,\nNEITHER ASGHAR (A.S.) REMAINS NOR HIS CRADLE

arabic text: LAHAD ME AAYE THAY JHULEKO CHHOR KAR ASGHAR\nTO ZALZALAONE LAHADKO BANAADLIYA JULA
english translation text: ASGHAR (A.S.) CAME TO HIS GRAVE LEAVING HIS CRADLE BEHIND,\nNOW HIS GRAVE HAS BECOME HIS CRADLE

arabic text: HAR AIK SHAHEED KA LAASHA THA SAAMNE USKE\nLIYE THAY HATHOME TASWIRE KARBALA
english translation text: IMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) HAD THE BODY OF EVERY MARTYR IN FRONT OF HIM,\nBUT HAS IN HIS HANDS THE MOST INNOCENT (ALI ASGHER A.S.) OF KARBALA
